name: football-transfer-live
description: World football transfer movement dashboard with a Sportmonks server-side adapter and demo fallback

scripts.check: npm run build && for file in server.js smoke-test.js scripts/sync-top5-players.js scripts/sync-demo-transfers.js scripts/import-player-socials.js scripts/verify-top5-players.js scripts/build-demo-report.js scripts/lib/env.js scripts/lib/psql.js scripts/lib/player-normalizer.js scripts/lib/sportmonks-client.js scripts/lib/import-sql.js scripts/lib/transfer-normalizer.js scripts/lib/transfer-import-sql.js scripts/lib/social-normalizer.js scripts/lib/social-import-sql.js test/player-sync.test.js test/transfer-sync.test.js test/social-sync.test.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node smoke-test.js && node --test test/player-sync.test.js test/transfer-sync.test.js test/social-sync.test.js
